summary: Improve metadata quality, lineage, ownership, and catalog workflows in five days. Explore the course and build practical governance artefacts.
lede: Metadata management organizes and maintains information about enterprise data assets. This intermediate training is for data governance professionals, including metadata managers, data architects, and stewards, who need to improve catalog records and stewardship workflows. It covers standardizing definitions, assigning ownership, checking metadata completeness, documenting lineage, and reporting catalog quality through practical work products.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for professionals who already contribute to data governance and need to improve enterprise metadata records, workflows, and reporting. It suits roles that define, curate, integrate, or oversee metadata across business and technical teams.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of data governance, data assets, or metadata workflows is expected. No programming is required for the course exercises; you will work with metadata examples, catalog records, and governance templates.
